info.title: The Four Main Styles
info.subtitle: Where the electronics sit changes everything

rows.title: Behind-the-ear (BTE)
rows.desc: Body rests on the ear; strong amplification

rows.title: Receiver-in-canal (RIC)
rows.desc: Most popular; discreet with a natural sound

rows.title: In-the-ear (ITE)
rows.desc: Custom-molded; easy to handle, no over-ear piece

rows.title: Invisible (IIC)
rows.desc: Sits deep in the canal; hardest to notice

rows.title: Choosing a style
rows.desc: Depends on your test, ears, and priorities
